# Safeword

AI code quality tool - enforces quality standards through hooks, linting, and guided workflows.

## Do Not Edit

**Safeword owns `.safeword/` and overwrites its framework files (SAFEWORD.md, guides, hooks, skills, templates) on `safeword install` and upgrade.** Exceptions: `.safeword/config.json` is yours to edit, and runtime data such as `.safeword/logs/` is preserved.

To customize agent behavior, put project rules in your root `AGENTS.md` (Codex and other AGENTS.md readers), `CLAUDE.md` (Claude Code), or `.cursor/rules/` (Cursor) instead.

See [SAFEWORD.md](./SAFEWORD.md) for full agent instructions.
